entities.title: Neon Snake
entities.summary: Snake made new, in Godot 4 for the web: a glowing snake that glides between cells, combos for quick bites, timed bonus stars, and a board that fits any window.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot project in godot/, the page's boot script in bridge/, the Worker that checks the sign-in and serves the game in worker/, the page's styles and headers in web/, and the Worker's tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: There is no server-side game state: the best score lives in the player's browser (Godot's user://, IndexedDB on the web).
The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
